text:
Maya Chen: Quick UX nit — the modal action shadow feels a bit heavy next to the new toolbar buttons, and toasts are overlapping the table header when the list is dense. Screenshot: https://redwood-assets.example/modal-shadow-toast.png :eyes:

Alex R.: Yeah I see it. Elevation mismatch. Modal CTA shadow reads much darker than toolbar. Also the primary ghost button focus ring looks a hair off contrast-wise on dark bg.

Jamie (design-bot): Proposed token tweak (diff):
```
--elevation-modal-action: 0 6px 18px rgba(2,6,23,0.12);
--elevation-modal-action: 0 4px 12px rgba(2,6,23,0.08);
```

Samir Patel: FWIW the toast is currently absolutely positioned inside the table container so it pushes/pulls content on show/hide. Suggest switching to `position: fixed` anchored to top + a small offset var(--space-3) so it doesn't shift layout.

Kelly Nguyen: Accessibility note — the primary ghost's focus stroke is 1px on dark surfaces. Recommend 2px + `outline-offset: 2px` for clearer keyboard focus. Also small copy tweak suggestion for the toast: 'Saved' -> 'Configuration saved' in console flows to reduce ambiguity.

Maya Chen: Nice. Can we turn those into named tokens so engineers can opt into them per surface? e.g., `--shadow-action-modal-sm` and `--toast-z-index-fixed` so we don't spread magic numbers.

Samir Patel: I'll open a tiny PR on `dev/experiments` that: 1) reduces modal-action shadow, 2) moves toast to fixed anchor with `top: calc(var(--space-3) + var(--header-height))`, 3) adjusts toast z-index down to 1100 to avoid covering menus. Will add a visual test. ETA today. :thumbsup:

Alex R.: One more — table row action dropdown currently has z-index 1200. If we lower toast to 1100, that should surface menus correctly. Otherwise we increase menu to 1250. I prefer lowering toast (less surprising).

Jamie (design-bot): Logged items in tracker: https://notion.redwood/design/shadows-toasts-1902345678. Tagged `ux-nit`, `accessibility`, `tokens`.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — if Samir's PR looks good I'll merge and update the component docs + a short migration note for anyone using the old elevation token. No objections? :sparkles:

Kelly Nguyen: No objections. Appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Samir Patel: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/834 — includes token defs, toast anchor change, and a screenshot diff.

Maya Chen: Reviewing now — will validate keyboard focus and table screenshots, then merge. :raised_hands:
